name: Mustarrd DVR Handoff
description: Mirrors Dispatcharr DVR recordings on catch-up channels to Mustarrd up to 72 hours ahead, then performs a final verified handoff before airtime.
author: matrix2669

fields.label: Mustarrd DVR Handoff
fields.description: Catch-up recordings are mirrored to Mustarrd in advance while Dispatcharr remains the fallback DVR. Inside the final handoff window, the plugin confirms Mustarrd still sees the channel as catch-up capable and verifies the Mustarrd schedule before deleting the Dispatcharr recording.

fields.label: Mustarrd URL
fields.help_text: Base URL reachable from the Dispatcharr container.

fields.label: Mustarrd Username
fields.help_text: Use a dedicated Mustarrd user. A download-only user is sufficient.

fields.label: Mustarrd Dispatcharr Account ID
fields.help_text: Mustarrd account that points to Dispatcharr's Xtream output. Dispatcharr Channel.id maps directly to the Xtream stream ID used by Mustarrd.

fields.label: Mirror Ahead (hours)
fields.help_text: Catch-up-capable Dispatcharr recordings this far in the future are mirrored into Mustarrd while the Dispatcharr recording remains scheduled.

fields.label: Final Handoff Before Airtime (minutes)
fields.help_text: Inside this window the plugin confirms Mustarrd currently sees the channel as catch-up capable and verifies the schedule before removing the Dispatcharr recording.

fields.label: Mirror / Handoff Check Schedule (cron)
fields.help_text: 5-field cron. The default checks every 5 minutes.

fields.label: TV Filename Template
fields.help_text: Available tags: {show}, {season}, {episode}, {title}, {date}, {channel}, {tmdb}, {tmdb_id}, {tvdb_id}, {imdb_id}. {tmdb} expands to Plex and Jellyfin tags. Do not include a file extension; Mustarrd appends .ts.

fields.label: Movie Filename Template
fields.help_text: Available tags: {title}, {year}, {date}, {channel}, {tmdb}, {tmdb_id}, {tvdb_id}, {imdb_id}. Do not include a file extension; Mustarrd appends .ts.

fields.label: Sports Filename Template
fields.help_text: Available tags: {title}, {date}, {channel}, {tmdb}, {tmdb_id}, {tvdb_id}, {imdb_id}. Do not include a file extension; Mustarrd appends .ts.

fields.label: Default Filename Template
fields.help_text: Used when the program is not classified as TV, movie, or sports. Do not include a file extension; Mustarrd appends .ts.

fields.label: Dry Run
fields.help_text: Evaluate and report mirroring/handoff decisions without creating Mustarrd schedules or deleting Dispatcharr recordings.

actions.label: Test Mustarrd
actions.description: Authenticate to Mustarrd and verify schedule API access.

actions.label: Run Mirror / Handoff Check Now
actions.description: Run the same mirror and final-handoff pass used by the cron task.

actions.label: Apply / Update Cron Schedule
actions.description: Register or update the periodic mirror/handoff task in Celery Beat.

actions.label: Show Cron Status
actions.description: Show the registered cron expression and recent run state.

actions.label: Remove Cron Schedule
actions.description: Stop automatic mirror/handoff checks. Existing Mustarrd and Dispatcharr schedules are not changed.

confirm.title: Remove automatic mirror/handoff schedule?
confirm.message: Automatic Mustarrd mirroring and handoffs will stop until the cron schedule is applied again.
